answer_1.quote: We propose KGI (Knowledge Graph Induction), a robust system for slot filling based on advanced training strategies for both Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) ... The RAG model is trained to predict the ground truth tail entity from the head and relation query.
answer_1.outputs: textual slot filler (entity strings) generated for given (head, relation) queries

answer_2.quote: The metrics we report include accuracy and F1 on the slot filler, where F1 is based on the recall and precision of the tokens in the answer ... We also use Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and HIT@k, with k = [1,5,10].
